temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth denies being upset with Keith and explains that she is dealing with personal stuff; she apologizes for seeming short.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth may be upset with him because of an unknown misunderstanding or mistake he made.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, from suspecting Elizabeth is upset with him to accepting her explanation that her curtness is due to personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is not angry with him; she is dealing with personal stress.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Be understanding and consider offering support to Elizabeth.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth accepts his offer of a coffee break/talk and thanks him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is under personal stress, not upset with him, and may appreciate support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, her acceptance confirms that she welcomes his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is receptive to his support and appreciates the offer.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Have coffee with Elizabeth and listen/support her.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over coffee, Elizabeth shares more about her stresses, which seem severe; when Keith suggests professional help, she says she has thought about it but is hesitant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth is stressed and receptive to support, and Keith wants to help but is unsure how to suggest professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, he learns her stress is severe and that she is hesitant about seeking professional help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth is dealing with severe stress and may benefit from professional help, but she is hesitant and the topic needs sensitivity.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Support her without pushing professional help and be careful about her feelings.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth becomes slightly withdrawn after his professional-help suggestion, then says he did not overstep and that she appreciates his concern; it is just a lot to think about.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: His suggestion may have embarrassed or offended Elizabeth because she withdrew.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, from fearing he overstepped to accepting her statement that he did not overstep and she appreciates his concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth was not offended; she appreciates his concern but is still processing a lot.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: regretful/anxious, then relieved but still concerned
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure her that he is supportive, avoid pushing professional help, and remain available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Elizabeth seems more open and appreciative; she says his support means a lot and that she feels better knowing she has it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Elizabeth appreciates his concern but is still processing; he wants to remain supportive without overstepping.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, her openness and thanks confirm and reinforce that she values his support and feels more comfortable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Elizabeth values his support and feels better; their supportive relationship is welcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the supportive relationship and remain available to chat or take breaks together.
